BatchConditionalText: Output text when the batch index matches the range and probability settings. Otherwise, output an empty string.
BatchConditionalTextWeight: Output prompts for matching batch indices, with a random weight for each comma-separated tag.
TextHorizontalToVertical: Convert horizontal text to vertical columns read from right to left. Disable conversion to keep the original text.
Moon_NE_Text_Concatenate: Join text inputs in order with a chosen separator. Connecting an input adds another socket.
batch_randoml_text: Pick one text input at random. Enter weights in socket order; larger numbers make an input more likely to be picked.
NTD11BatchMosaic: Apply mosaic to detected regions in a folder of videos, with optional subfolders and audio preservation.
NTD11VideoMosaic: Apply mosaic to detected regions in the selected video and keep its audio.
NTD11VideoFile: Choose a video from your computer.
